Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler that would run it is refusing connections: the gateway's cron service needs credentials this session doesn't have, so I couldn't create the recurring job. Nothing has been scheduled, and nothing has been posted to the channel.

Once the scheduler is working, I'd set it up as a Monday 08:00 (America/Chicago) job, starting Monday 19 October, that posts in #coastal-team from #coastal-team and #coastal-random. The membership of both channels is the same (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reveal anything the channels don't already show. It will leave out money terms like rates, prices, discounts and contract values, since those can't go into a channel without approval from Anselm or June. Operational items like ticket numbers, seat counts, dates and contacts are fine.

If you'd like me to retry, or someone with Gateway access can restore the scheduler credentials, let me know and I'll create it.
